newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-NANTES SCORE SEVEN, PSG OPEN SIX-POINT LEAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NANTES SCORE SEVEN, PSG OPEN SIX-POINT LEAD.

text.p: Nantes ended their 10-match run without a win with a specatular 7-0 rout of Nice while leaders Paris Saint-Germain beat Le Havre 2-0 to open a six-point gap at the top of the French first division on Saturday.
PSG, inspired by Brazilian Leonardo, scorer of their first goal, lead from Monaco.
Brazilian Anderson struck twice in Monaco's 3-1 home win over Rennes.
Bastia crashed 3-1 at Montpellier to drop to third behind Monaco on goal difference.
Seven different players scored for Nantes, the struggling 1995 champions who had previously taken only five points from five draws.
Champions Auxerre came from behind to draw 1-1 at Cannes with a goal by their defender Alain Goma, called up to the French national team this week.
Metz striker Robert Pires, another member of Aime Jacquet's squad for next week's friendly at home to Turkey, was sent off during his side's 2-2 draw at Lens.
